en: The postcard features a sepia-toned photograph of a large Byzantine-style church with a prominent dome and bell tower, partially obscured by trees or vegetation. The architecture is characterized by rounded arches and cross-topped spires. There is a visible stamp and postmark in the lower left corner. At the bottom of the postcard, there is printed text in both French and Greek, as well as a website watermark.
